# Roskilde Pædiatri

Roskilde Pædiatri is a pediatric department within the Danish health system that participates in the DANIBD registry, a national quality-monitoring program for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) diagnostics. The department achieved a 90% compliance rate with indicator 1b, which measures complete diagnostic workup for newly diagnosed IBD in children and young people [^src1]. This performance exceeds the national development target of 80%, positioning Roskilde Pædiatri as a high-performing unit in pediatric IBD diagnostics.

Indicator 1b specifically assesses whether children and young patients receive a comprehensive diagnostic evaluation consisting of gastroscopy, colonoscopy, and magnetic resonance imaging or capsule endoscopy [^src1]. According to the broader DANIBD monitoring framework documented in 2024, only 69% of departments nationally meet this standard, making Roskilde Pædiatri's 90% compliance a notable achievement [^src1]. The department's performance demonstrates the feasibility of delivering complete diagnostic protocols in pediatric IBD care and may serve as a benchmark for other Danish hospital departments.
